requiresDeployedNote: source-store.ts switched both ON CONFLICT arbiters from (workspace_id, kind, owner_user_id) to (workspace_id, kind, owner_user_id, provider_account_id); its parent commit still carried the three-column tuple at lines 112 and 243
rationale: 975 is the CONTRACT step for migrations 959/960 and drops trigger_sources_owned_user_kind_uidx. Every writer that could name that index as an ON CONFLICT arbiter lives in packages/operator-core/lib/external-triggers/source-store.ts, and from ca06a5ea onward both of its arbiters name the four-column account-aware tuple served by trigger_sources_owned_account_kind_uidx, which 959/960 created and this migration leaves in place. Keeping the three-column index would reject a second provider account, so the drop is the correct contract step rather than something to revert.
